summary: Frontend-only test of the redesign at 1920 and 390px (plus a footer measurement at 768). Almost every requested flow passes. Loader: counts 000 to 100 and is gone by about 2.5s. Hero: headline, compass, compass-node-0..4 and hero-label-0..4 all update hero-readout correctly (Direction/Validation/Blueprint/Growth/Legacy). The readout auto-cycles about every 3.2s and stops after the user picks an item. hero-start and hero-book scroll to #contact (top=0). Marquee renders. manifesto-01/02/03 words reach opacity 1 when scrolled. values-rose shows all 6 values. Services desktop: default panel is 02 Business Blueprint; hovering 01-05 swaps the panel, each with a blueprint SVG and the matching service-more-0N href; service-more-05 opens /services/investment-preparation. Services mobile: 5 stacked cards, each with service-0N and service-more-0N. Insights desktop: the section pins (heading stays at 194px) and the cards move from x=258 to -3007 over the scroll; the last card ends inside the viewport; clicking insight-7 opens the article. Insights mobile: the swipe row scrolls (scrollWidth 2718); clicking a card opens the article. faq-0..5 open and close; more-questions goes to /faq. cta-start scrolls to contact. Beacon IST time updates every second. Contact: one submission, POST /api/contact returned 200 and the form reset; the empty-form check shows an error toast. footer-mega renders. Footer links are correct. scroll-compass shows on desktop and its bearing changes with scroll (000 to 360); it is hidden on mobile. scroll-progress works. Nav: all desktop links and all mobile drawer links (nav-m-*) work, including About to /about and scrolling to services and contact from /faq; body overflow is reset after the drawer closes. Subpages /about, /insights, /insights/idea-to-business, /faq and /services/business-blueprint render with nav and footer at both widths. No horizontal page overflow at 390 on any page. No console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px and 768px the 'SYMSTRUO' text is wider than its container and the last 'O' is cut off by overflow-hidden. Measured text width vs box: 390px 408 vs 342; 768px 799 vs 672. It fits at 1920 because of lg:text-[17rem]. text-[21vw] is too large once the px-6/px-12 padding is taken off. Use about text-[17vw] (md:text-[16vw]), or fit the text to the container width.

issues: The fixed scroll-compass (bottom-right, z-40) sits over the hero's bottom-bar label 'TRUE NORTH'; only 'TRUE NO' is visible. Add right padding to the hero bottom bar on lg screens, or move the label.
Sonner toasts (position bottom-right) appear right on top of the scroll-compass and hide it. Consider placing toasts bottom-center or top-right, or offsetting them.
The 'KNOW MORE ↗' link wraps onto two lines ('KNOW' / 'MORE') on cards 01, 02 and 03, because the long italic outcome text squeezes it. Add whitespace-nowrap and shrink-0 to MoreLink.

The large outline numerals (01/02/03) sit behind the headline words and lower readability slightly, mostly on statement 02, where the '02' outline overlaps 'without direction is'. Consider lower opacity or moving them on mobile.
The index numbers (01..07, text-[var(--grey-2)]) have very low contrast against the ink background and are barely visible.

The hero h1 innerText includes the decorative bearing ('Direction Before 108° Execution.'). Add aria-hidden to the bearing span, or move it out of the h1. Manifesto words are separate spans with no real spaces, so copied text comes out as 'Everysuccessfulcompany'. The aria-label is present, so screen readers are fine. Add {' '} between the Word spans to fix copy and search indexing.

action_items: Fix the footer-mega clipping on mobile and tablet: reduce the base font size (for example text-[17vw]) so 'SYMSTRUO' fits inside the padded container at 390 and 768.
Stop the scroll-compass covering the hero 'TRUE NORTH' label on desktop, and stop toasts covering the compass.
Add whitespace-nowrap to the service 'KNOW MORE' link on the mobile cards.
Optional: add aria-hidden to the hero bearing span inside the h1; add real spaces between the manifesto Word spans; raise the contrast of the FAQ index numbers.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 760 lines and still holds About, FAQ, Insights index, Article, Contact, Footer and ServiceDetail. Split it into pages and components (over the 700-line guideline).
Footer and Toaster blocks are repeated across the page components (Toaster appears in 3 places). Move them into a single layout component.

CircleCursor is correctly disabled for (hover:none)/(pointer:coarse). Headless mobile emulation reports pointer:fine, so the ring showed in the 390px screenshots. That is a test-environment artifact, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all functional flows pass; 1 medium visual bug and several minor design issues)

seed_data_creation: One contact submission: TEST QA Iter3 / qa+20@example.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wait about 4s after load (loader). Use JS click (e.evaluate('e=>e.click()')) or dispatch_event for compass nodes, insight cards and FAQ (faq-N is the button itself). On desktop the insights section height is 100vh + track distance (about 4346px at 1920). To check footer-mega clipping, compare a Range on its text nodes with the element's box at 390 and 768.
rca of the issue: Footer clipping: .footer-mega uses text-[21vw] with overflow-hidden and whitespace-nowrap inside a container with 24px/48px side padding. 8 Cormorant capitals at 21vw come to about 1.05x the viewport width, more than the padded container, so the right edge is clipped. Only lg:text-[17rem] fits.
